reviews.checked_passages: Theorem4.1.6 printed pp.19–20: the omission construction, retaining the named elementary submodel as required by SCHLICHT-04.
reviews.outcome: No new serious defect found beyond SCHLICHT-04, now repaired in the corpus. The adopted argument explicitly lifts finite constant support to free variables, includes repeated tuple names through equality constraints, keeps each added condition finite, and covers countably many varying finite arities. Omission is asserted for the named elementary submodel, not an arbitrary ambient model; the latter distinction is proved in the question. Broader topological or meager-set omission results are outside this entry.
